title: Failing 'plead the ring down, plain' and 'swear a new oath over the stone' at the same oath-stone each printed '(the Watch -1)' with no prior warning in the menu — unlike risky checks elsewhere that say 'a fail costs 1hp' up front, and unlike the wits check at the same spot ('puzzle out the old oath') which failed for free and said 'it can be tried again.'
where: The Oath-Ground — Circle / 'plead the ring down, plain', 'swear a new oath over the stone'
